sloka: आहूतश्च पुनस्तेन शत्रुघ्नेन महात्मना ।लवणः क्रोधसंयुक्तो युद्धाय समुपस्थितः ।। ७.६९.३३ ॥
transliteration: āhūtaśca punastena śatrughnena mahātmanā ।lavaṇaḥ krodhasaṁyukto yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ ।। 7.69.33 ॥

translations.english: And again, challenged by the great-souled Shatrughna, Lavana, filled with anger, appeared ready for battle.
